text:
jennifer-csm: Heads-up — Nimbus Health is showing a sustained spike in token usage and a rising error rate. Forecast says they could hit the hard cap by Saturday. Weekly check flagged: tokens +42% (24h), spend +36%, p95 latency 440ms (was 210ms), error rate ~0.9%. We should coordinate a temporary cap adjustment + customer comms.

alicia.cs: Can we do a short soft-limit raise? 24–48h window to avoid throttles and give them time to optimize.

mike.eng: Technically we can enable a 20–30% soft bump and route overflow to dedicated pool if needed. Need ops sign-off and a quick cost delta estimate.

raj.ops: Ops update: dedicated pool has ~20% headroom for the next 36h without squeezing other tenants. I can authorize a +20% soft limit for Nimbus for 36h. If you want +30% we'll need a short reservation (30m lead).

jennifer-csm: Draft comm I propose to send (short, consultative):
```
Subject: Temporary capacity change for your account — no action needed

Hi Sara / Nimbus team,

We noticed a spike in usage on your account. To avoid any disruption over the weekend we've temporarily increased your soft usage limit for 36 hours. This is a safety measure — there will be no change to your billing or SLAs, and no action is required. If you'd like us to review usage patterns or set a custom rate plan, we can schedule a quick call.

—Jennifer (Redwood CSM)
```

alicia.cs: Short and clear. Suggest add a one-line about who to ping for questions and a link to our usage dashboard.

jennifer-csm: Updated draft: added dashboard link and contact.

mike.eng: One operational ask: can we bump KV cache TTL for their top prefix to cut repeated context regeneration? That should reduce token burn by ~10–15%.

raj.ops: We can run the cache TTL change now; low risk. I'll also create a temporary routing policy so overflow hits the dedicated pool instead of triggering hard-throttles.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4521 for temporary limit change + routing policy; assignees: raj.ops, mike.eng. ETA: 30m to enact.

alicia.cs: CSM ask — can you confirm estimated cost delta for +20% for 36h so I can note it in the comms if Finance asks?

mike.eng: Quick estimate: for their instance profile, +20% throughput for 36h ≈ ~$450 incremental cloud/GPU cost. I'll post a short calc in the ticket.

jennifer-csm: Thanks team. Plan: raj enacts +20% now for 36h, mike applies KV TTL bump, I'll send the customer message once INF-4521 shows 'in progress'. I'll also offer a 30-min tuning session next week. @alicia.cs — can you be on the email?

alicia.cs: Yep, I'll co-send. :thumbsup:

raj.ops: Starting the change now. Will update ticket and ping when live.

ops-bot: INF-4521 status -> in_progress (raj.ops).

jennifer-csm: Ack — I'll wait 5–10m and then send. Thanks all.

alicia.cs: Nice quick sync.

mike.eng: Noted for runbook: consider auto-soft-bump for accounts with repeat weekend spikes.

jennifer-csm: Filing a follow-up item in our weekly ops checklist.

raj.ops: Change completed. INF-4521 -> resolved. Routing policy applied, +20% soft limit for 36h, KV TTL bumped. Observability shows immediate drop in token regen on top prefixes.

ops-bot: INF-4521 status -> resolved.

jennifer-csm: Sent message to Nimbus (cc: alicia.cs). They replied: “Thanks — that helps, we'll review usage and follow up.” Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
